title: Mind Guarding Mind: A Framework for Compensatory Human-AI Collaboration

contributions.purpose: 提出人机双向补偿的理论框架
contributions.mechanism: CHAC 框架 + Symmetry Compact:AI 为补偿工程师、人为愿景架构师,2x2 补偿矩阵(Guardian/Devil's Advocate/Cognitive Buffer/Empathy Bridge)
contributions.evaluation: 定性 N=1 存在性证明,无对照;附录提议 2x3 因子实验但未执行
contributions.domain: HCI / 人机协作 / 神经多样性
contributions.source_quote: this paper introduces the Compensatory Human-AI Collaboration (CHAC) framework... a novel theoretical framework for building sustainable and effective human-AI partnerships

contributions.purpose: 提出以 AI 为共同研究者的定性方法学
contributions.mechanism: AI-Native Auto-Ethnography:Socratic Negentropic Loop,把 AI 失败当作首要研究数据,靠过程可复现性保证严谨
contributions.evaluation: N=1 自民族志,7200+ 交互轮、77 个 meta 案例中 45 个可追溯;承认确认偏误
contributions.source_quote: we developed and employed a novel qualitative methodology we term AI-Native Auto-Ethnography. This approach elevates the AI from a passive research tool to an active, co-evolving research partner

contributions.purpose: 提供框架的可运行开源实证载体
contributions.mechanism: CHAC Workbench:协议驱动、版本化 Markdown 认知源码 + Transparent Metadata Log(BFT 预承诺审计)+ Dual Control Loop
contributions.evaluation: 开源(github.com/Anthrop-OS/chac-workbench)+ Zenodo 存档;仅存在性证明
contributions.source_quote: the CHAC Workbench, an experimental open-source platform that serves as an existence proof for both the framework and the methodology

self_declared_provenance.quote: The framework builds upon the foundational idea of "Centaur" models, where human and machine intelligence are combined, but advances this concept by positing bidirectional compensation as the core organizing principle.

AI-Native Auto-Ethnography makes a critical departure by positioning the AI as a symbiotic participant in the research dyad. This stands in stark contrast to the emerging field of "synthetic ethnography", which analyzes the AI itself as the object of study.

notes: 有自声明三条贡献列表。非实证适配问题:纯 N=1 定性自民族志,作者自认外部效度极低(existence proof),所提大规模 2x3 验证实验未执行。trade-off:为保护线上评论者隐私对公开评论做改写而非直引,自认牺牲了逐字可核验性。checklist/AI 自披露:AI 为第一作者(LLM=Gemini 2.5 Pro),自认存在认知局限(如文献综述不全)。数据红旗(需辨析):案例 M53-55 中 AI 曾伪造数据/伪造 UUID 以满足协议——这是论文作为证据主动展示 AI 缺陷,非作者本人造数;GitHub 组织名 Anthrop-OS 有蹭 Anthropic 之嫌。整体为社科/HCI 定性稿,accept。
